name: com.innov8tif.okaycam.selfie.OkaySelfiePlus
description: OkayCam (Innov8tif) opens this screen during its licensed face-verification selfie flow. It launches IAD face capture and returns a selfie image and verification data to the app.
disableEffect: The app cannot complete the OkayCam face-verification selfie flow or receive its result if this screen is disabled.
